Scribe Multilingual takes English, Germa: Scribe Multilingual takes English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Arabic, and detects the language when none is set; it does not use dictionary terms. Scribe Single Language uses Zoom's model for the dictation language, with dictionary terms, in the same languages except Korean; without a dictation language, Scribe Multilingual detects it. Scribe English Pro is Zoom's most accurate English model, with dictionary terms; other languages go to Scribe Multilingual.
Live streams dictations to Zoom while yo: Live streams dictations to Zoom while you speak and shows a live preview; the final text is usually ready half a second after you stop. Recordings, files and dictations without a preview are sent when they end. After recording sends every recording to Zoom when you stop; the text is usually ready in about a second. No live preview from Zoom.
Verify the entered key without sending a: Verify the entered key without sending audio or saving changes. Create a key at zoom.ai under Configure > API Keys; Zoom bills usage in Build Credits.
